draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.cose-shape: COSE_Sign1 under tag 18, alg -7, a kid, and CWT Claims carrying iss and sub (Section 5.5)
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.signature: the ES256 signature verifies under the operator's registered key
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.content-hash: content_hash is SHA-256 over the payload bytes (Section 5.7)
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.chain-hash: chain_hash is SHA-256 over the 76 + len(agent_id) byte pre-image of Section 5.7
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.sequence: sequence_number is one more than the preceding record's, or zero first (Section 5.8 step 4)
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.header-payload: the header's action_timestamp_ms and agent_id equal the payload's [corpus]
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.prev-chain-link: prev_chain_hash equals the preceding record's chain_hash, or all zero first [corpus]
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.time-order: action_timestamp_ms is not below the preceding record's [corpus]
draft-emirdag-scitt-ai-agent-execution-0.position-unique: no two records claim one (agent_id, sequence_number) [corpus]

draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.deterministic-encoding: the checkpoint, its protected header and its payload are core deterministic CBOR, so no map repeats a key [corpus; Section 4.2 binds only the producer]
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.cose-shape: COSE_Sign1 under tag 18, alg -19, and CWT Claims whose (iss, sub) is the case's log identity
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.signature: the Ed25519 signature verifies under the producer key
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.claims: kind is cll-checkpoint and the required claims carry Table 1's types (Section 4.3 step 2)
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.continuity: prev_size and prev_commitment equal the service's last registration, or the service holds none and prev_size is 0 (Section 4.5)
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.issued-at-order: issued_at is not earlier than the service's last registered issued_at [corpus]
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.registration-time: the service's clock is within the declared cadence of issued_at [corpus]
draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log-0.history-fork: no other named service holds a registration of the same log_size with another commitment [corpus]

draft-gruszka-scitt-statement-identifica.duplicate-key: no map in the protected header repeats a key (Section 6)
draft-gruszka-scitt-statement-identifica.signature: the Ed25519 signature verifies under the issuer key
draft-gruszka-scitt-statement-identifica.identity: SHA-256 over ToBeSigned, with the protected header in its deterministic encoding, equals the reference digest [corpus; the draft hashes the header bytes as written]

comparisonSurface.note: A verifier conforms on a member when its verdict equals expected.verdict, or, for an indeterminate member, is one of the verdicts its readings list. The codes name the reference reader's first refusal; the drafts define none. A rule marked [corpus] is one the draft's text does not state, and draftReading is the verdict the draft's own procedure reaches without it: every member where the two differ is a case the draft's verification steps do not catch.

note: Each member is one case file: the bytes a verifier reads, as hex, and the state it reads them against. What the verifier must decide lives here and never beside the input. does_not_assert lists what the expected verdict does not establish, so a verdict is never read as more than it is.
